description: The voicebot speaks `text` aloud in the call (verbatim in normal mode; in a live room the voice rephrases it and the answer has verbatim false, mode live_paraphrase). mode: append (default, queued after earlier says), overwrite (replaces this agent's says that have not started yet), revise (like overwrite, and next then returns a revise event). Returns ok and seq.
name: say
title: Speak in the call
